column1: # Node release lines and the first release of each that carries the fixes of Node's latest security advisory.
# Read by eval/doctor.sh and the Studio server (studio/server/lib/node-advisory.js); one table, two readers.
# A Node below its line's release, or on a line older than the newest listed that is not listed (it gets no fixes),
# is warned about, never refused: the gates are bash, Node runs the panel and the map, and the user updates it.
# A line newer than every listed one is not judged. Update this file when Node publishes a new advisory.
